name: figconn
description: Local MCP bridge between Claude Code and Figma Desktop with no REST API and no rate limits. Read, build and edit designs, variables, styles and components through a dev plugin over localhost WebSocket.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-plugin.js && node --check server/index.js && for f in server/tools/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && node --check plugin/code.js
